subject: Ciências
description_pt: Descrever características de plantas e animais (tamanho, forma, cor, fase da vida, local onde se desenvolvem etc.) que fazem parte de seu cotidiano e relacioná-las ao ambiente em que eles vivem.

components.description_pt: Descrever características observáveis de plantas e animais encontrados na vida diária (tamanho, forma, cor, estágio de vida, habitat)
components.description_en: Describe observable characteristics of plants and animals encountered in daily life (size, shape, color, life stage, habitat)
components.cc_component_description: Make systematic observations of plants and animals living in different habitats

components.description_pt: Relacionar características específicas de um organismo ao ambiente em que vive
components.description_en: Relate specific characteristics of an organism to the environment in which it lives
components.cc_component_description: Describe how environmental characteristics of an area influence which organisms can live there

components.description_pt: Comparar características de dois organismos vivendo em ambientes diferentes
components.description_en: Compare characteristics of two organisms living in different environments
components.cc_component_description: Explain why different kinds of organisms are found in different environmental conditions

cc_matches.description: There are many different kinds of living things in any area, and they exist in different places on land and in water.
Make observations of plants and animals to compare the diversity of life in different habitats.
